Intake note (Commercial team, 27 September 2024). Our client Kiran Sandhu is a 27-year-old electrician who lives at Bungalow 1, Hanamkonda, Warangal 506007 and can be reached on 88020 44344 or kiran.sandhu@example.in. The client's PAN HKEPS5419D.
